$comment: An alternative to the sky card's sunset, kept to reproduce it: the Sun 3° above the Earth's edge rather than 2°. The Sun stands higher, as in the card's illustration, but the edge below it is past sunset no longer, so the orange band fades to white towards the Sun.
name: sky-sunset-orbit-sun-3deg
description: The sky card's orbital sunset with the Sun 3° above the Earth's edge.
